steps: Open a qualified Service 1st FCU checking account at https://service1.org/promo-landing-pages/tick-tock!-checking — mention or present the offer when opening ($5 savings balance plus $1 one-time membership fee).
Enroll in Digital Banking and eStatements and get your debit card.
Complete one debit card transaction within 30 days of opening (earns the first $150).
Receive a qualifying direct deposit of at least $250 within 30 days of opening (earns the second $150).
Keep the account open at least six months (bonus is deducted if closed earlier).
The bonus is deposited within 90 business days after requirements are met. Offer expires December 31, 2026.
